fr:title.text: Presheaves are monadic and comonadic over families

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Presheaves are monadic and comonadic over families

fr:mainmatter.html:p: For a category \mathcal {C}, restricting a presheaf to its family of sets over the objects of \mathcal {C} has both a left adjoint (free) and a right adjoint (cofree), and the presheaf category is both monadic and comonadic over families (Presheaf.Family.Base).

The branch supplies the displayed categories of algebras and coalgebras, the Eilenberg--Moore and co-Eilenberg--Moore categories, and their comparison functors. The cofree comonad on families is what the later modality is assembled from.
Also lands: sub-presheaves and sieves (Presheaf.Sieve, Subobject.Base), needed for the strict-downset sieve.

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: The lob branch: direct categories, Löb induction, and intrinsic hylomorphisms

fr:mainmatter.html:p: Summary of the lob branch's diffs to main: a self-contained account of well-founded recursion in Cubical Agda, from categorical foundations up to concrete algorithms verified by type. Target: Max New's guarded/direct-category development.

html:ul.html:li: Presheaves are monadic and comonadic over families --- the (co)Eilenberg--Moore foundation the guarded modality rests on.
Direct categories, the later modality, and Löb induction --- the recursion principle.
Intrinsic hylomorphisms: the output carrier is the specification --- the payoff, a roster of verified algorithms.

fr:mainmatter.html:p: Infrastructure: measure-ordered direct categories via pullbackWFOrder.
Where next: directions for direct-category recursion.
Open threads: a shared half has no clean home; intrinsic shortest-path and streams are in flight.

fr:title.text: Direct categories, the later modality, and Löb induction

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Direct categories, the later modality, and Löb induction

fr:mainmatter.html:p: A direct category carries a well-founded degree functor (Direct.Base: directness as a displayed StructureOver plus GlobalSection; Direct.WellFounded). The strict-downset sieve of maps of strictly smaller degree (Direct.StrictDownset) defines the later modality \triangleright as a presheaf endofunctor with a next unit.

Löb induction is the guarded fixed point: a map \triangleright A \to A has a unique fixed point, computing definitionally because WFOrder lives in the Eq-world. Exposed as a presheaf-level löb and a family-level strong recursion löbStr.

Direct.LocallyContractive: a locally contractive functor is a \Sigma of an object-action and a \triangleright -hom action; its hylo is Löb applied to the fused (co)algebra. Direct.Product gives lexicographic products of direct categories.
Notation: families are objects of the family category, exposed as Löb.Fam, so instances never respell ob → hSet by hand.
